title: Should AI tutors replace most classroom teaching for core subjects?
pro_framing: AI tutors can give every student personalized, infinitely patient instruction at a fraction of the cost of human-led classrooms.
con_framing: Teaching is fundamentally relational; replacing most human instruction with AI would damage motivation, social development, and accountability.

title: Should governments enforce a minimum age of 16 for social media accounts?
pro_framing: Strong evidence links early social media use to mental health harm in adolescents; an enforced age limit protects a vulnerable group.
con_framing: Age limits are unenforceable in practice, push teens toward less moderated spaces, and override parental judgment.

title: Should a four-day work week become the standard for full-time employment?
pro_framing: Trials consistently show maintained or improved productivity with better wellbeing; the standard week is an outdated default.
con_framing: A shorter standard week raises costs and staffing complexity for many employers and doesn't suit every industry equally.
